main:
[DEFINE_WORKER: "Reads test cases from standard input, simulates a tour of moves, BFS-searches for the nearest tour point from a transformed start, and prints the minimal meeting time or IMPOSSIBLE for each case." main]
    [INPUTS]
        <REF> args </REF>: String[] "Command-line arguments passed to main; not used by the program."
    [END_INPUTS]

    [OUTPUTS]
    [END_OUTPUTS]

    [MAIN_FLOW]
        [SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
            [COMMAND Initialize dx = {0,1,0,-1}, dy = {1,0,-1,0}, create a Scanner over System.in, initialize StringBuilder ans, and read the integer T from standard input. RESULT _input_setup]
            [COMMAND For each test case t from 1 to T inclusive, read integer X, integer Y, and string M; create a 2001 by 2001 int grid g; set px=1000 and py=1000; initialize List<List<Integer>> tour with an ArrayList te containing (px,py); add te to tour; mark g[py][px]=1. RESULT _test_case_state]
            [COMMAND Within the test-case loop, for each index i from 0 to M.length()-1, read char d=M.charAt(i); if d=='N' decrement py, if d=='S' increment py, if d=='E' increment px, if d=='W' decrement px; mark g[py][px]=1; create a new te, add (px,py), and append it to tour. RESULT _tour_and_grid]
            [COMMAND Within the test-case loop, create boolean visited[2001][2001], set myx=1000-X, myy=1000+Y, create LinkedList q with initial Pair(myx,myy,0), set tmp=-1, nearX=-1, and nearY=-1. RESULT _bfs_initial_state]
            [COMMAND Within the test-case loop, while q is not empty, poll Pair now; if g[now.y][now.x]==1, store tmp=now.dist, nearX=now.x, nearY=now.y and break; mark visited[now.y][now.x]=true; for v=0..3 compute nx=now.x+dx[v] and ny=now.y+dy[v]; skip if nx<0 or nx>=visited[0].length or ny<0 or ny>=visited.length or visited[ny][nx] is true; otherwise add Pair(nx,ny,now.dist+1) to q. RESULT _nearest_path_cell]
            [COMMAND Within the test-case loop, append the string "Case #" + t + ": " to ans. RESULT ans]
            [COMMAND Within the test-case loop, if tmp == -1, append the string "IMPOSSIBLE\n" to ans and continue to the next test case. RESULT ans]
            [COMMAND When tmp != -1, within the test-case loop, initialize ti=0; search tour for the first index i whose coordinate equals (nearX,nearY) and store it in ti. RESULT _tour_index]
            [COMMAND When tmp != -1, within the test-case loop, create boolean visited2[2001][2001]; if tmp <= ti, append tmp + (ti-tmp+1)/2 using integer division, followed by a newline, to ans. RESULT ans]
            [COMMAND When tmp != -1 and tmp > ti, within the test-case loop, initialize success=false; for i from ti while i < tour.size() and tmp-ti+i < tour.size(), set visited2 at tour.get(tmp+i-ti) to true; if tour.get(i) is already marked, append i followed by a newline to ans, set success=true and break. RESULT _catchup_success]
            [COMMAND Within the test-case loop, when tmp > ti and the loop finishes without success, append the string "IMPOSSIBLE\n" to ans. RESULT ans]
            [COMMAND After all test cases have been processed, print the accumulated ans to standard output. RESULT _final_output]
        [END_SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
    [END_MAIN_FLOW]

[END_WORKER]
